Represents shares earned from the FY24-FY26 Performance Share Unit ("PSU") award granted on November 16, 2023, as certified by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors. Earned PSUs became 100% vested on the last day of the performance period. The PSUs were measured against adjusted EPS performance goals over three separate one-year measurement periods and for a three-year measurement period, each measurement period was weighted equally at 25%. The entire PSU was subject to a payment modifier (-25%, 0%, or +25%) based on Valvoline's total shareholder return ("TSR") over the three-year performance period relative to the companies in the S&P 400 MidCap 400 Index. Based on Valvoline's adjusted EPS and TSR performance, the Committee awarded a PSU payout equal to 54% of target. || PSUs convert into Valvoline Common Stock on a one-for-one basis.
